angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 723,528 km at 177.19 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.6437 +/- 0.0123 mas (same row, RUWE 0.78): 177.19 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.04 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-4507 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract): 723,528 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.11 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-4507 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6260 +/- 80 K from Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4507 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-4507 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-4507.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.449, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4507 (pscomppars): spectral type F, from Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4507 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.06 dex, from Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4507 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.14922, from Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4507 (pscomppars): age 0.7 Gyr, from Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-4507 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 7.3 km/s, from Espinoza-Retamal et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ...996L..13E/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
